definitions.simple: A nucleotide containing ribose sugar, a nitrogenous base, and one or more phosphate groups. Ribonucleotides are the building blocks of RNA.
definitions.scientific: A ribonucleotide is a nucleobase-linked ribose with one or more phosphate groups. Its ribose retains a hydroxyl group at the 2′ position, unlike a deoxyribonucleotide.
